# PodMic USB — DSP encoder tables

The seven 256-entry `uint32` tables RØDE Central uses to encode the table fields of report `0x04`
([spec §10.2](podmic-usb-hid-spec.md#102-table-fields)). Compute the index `i` with the formula given, then send
`T[i]` as a little-endian `uint32`. Extracted from RØDE Central 2.2.0 (`rode_bridge.dll`; the Android bridge has
the same data); every captured value matches. Machine-readable copy: [`podmic-dsp-tables.json`](podmic-dsp-tables.json).

Rows are `i = row … row+7`.
